title_zh: 文学、艺术与体育 — 第27节
body_en: Film scenes can teach narrative: setting, conflict, ending. Pause and predict what happens next. Discuss theme without ruining the ending for others. Then write your own ending in English — short and clear.
body_zh: 电影场景能教叙事：背景、冲突、结局。暂停并预测下一步。讨论主题时别破坏别人对结局的期待。然后用英语写你自己的结局——短而清楚。
